lines.t: A dentist visited a cave full of bats... and thought: these could win a war.
Because a bat weighs about half an ounce. And it can fly carrying a tiny fire bomb that weighs even more than it does.
His plan: pack a thousand sleeping bats into a metal tube with a parachute, and drop them over cities full of wooden houses.
Bats? Sure. And next we'll train squirrels!
But the President read his letter... and wrote: this man is not a nut.
So the army chilled the bats in ice cube trays to make them sleep. Then clipped a tiny bomb to each one.
They're gonna nap through the whole war!
Then, at a desert air base, somebody left a door open.
The bats woke up. With live bombs still clipped on.
And they did exactly what bats do. They found the darkest corners they could reach.
You see, a normal fire bomb hits the roof. A bat crawls inside. Under the beams, into the attic, right where nobody can reach the flames.
In later tests, bat bombs started about ten times more fires than normal ones.
But the project was too slow. It was cancelled after two million dollars.
And that first escape? The bats burned down an aircraft hangar...
If you were the general. A, keep the bats. Or B, buy a new car.
